UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: VIP user account profile strictly tracking dual-currency tonBalance (TON) and starsBalance (Telegram Stars), TON Connect wallet, and referral metrics

tonBalance.description: Primary user wallet balance in TON (💎 TON)

starsBalance.description: Primary user wallet balance in Telegram Stars (⭐ Stars)

referralCode.description: Unique VIP referral code for this user

referralEarningsTon.description: Total TON earned from 2% referral commission out of the 15% site share

referralEarningsStars.description: Total Telegram Stars earned from referral commission

referredTicketsCount.description: Total tickets purchased by referred friends

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update

PlatformSettings.title: PlatformSettings
PlatformSettings.description: Official TON treasury deposit wallet, high-value withdrawal threshold, and pari-mutuel solvency configuration

COLD_TREASURY.description: Admin hardware cold storage TON wallet address

autoWithdrawLimitTon.description: Maximum TON amount for instant automatic withdrawal before requiring admin approval

DepositRecord.title: DepositRecord
DepositRecord.description: On-chain auto-verified TON Connect 2.0 or Telegram Stars (XTR) deposit record

userUid.description: User UID who initiated the deposit

userDisplayName.description: Display name of the depositing user

currency.description: Sole supported deposit currencies: TON or Telegram Stars

amountStars.description: Deposited amount in Telegram Stars (⭐ Stars)

txHash.description: Unique TON blockchain BOC hash or Telegram Stars charge ID

verificationMethod.description: Automatic verification via TON Connect or Telegram Stars webhook

ReferralLink.title: ReferralLink
ReferralLink.description: Unique referral code and URL generated for a user and stored in Firestore with TON and Stars commission metrics

ownerUid.description: UID of the user who owns this referral link

commissionRatePercent.description: Commission percentage carved strictly from the 15% site share (default 2%)

totalReferredTickets.description: Total tickets purchased via this referral link

totalCommissionEarnedTon.description: Total TON commission earned from net lottery profit

totalCommissionEarnedStars.description: Total Telegram Stars commission earned from net lottery profit

netHouseProfitRetainedTon.description: Total net TON profit retained by the house after deducting referral commission

ReferralCommissionLedger.title: ReferralCommissionLedger
ReferralCommissionLedger.description: Immutable financial ledger entry proving referral commission in TON/Stars was deducted strictly from the 15% site share with zero house loss

referrerCode.description: Referral code that earned the commission

buyerDisplayName.description: Display name of the ticket buyer

ticketGrossTon.description: Gross ticket purchase amount in TON

prizePool85Ton.description: 85% distributable prize pool allocation in TON

siteShare15Ton.description: 15% site share in TON before referral deduction

commissionDeductedTon.description: 2% referral commission in TON deducted exclusively from the 15% site share

netHouseProfitRetainedTon.description: Guaranteed net TON profit retained by the house

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile, tonBalance, starsBalance, TON wallet, Telegram handle, and referral stats

/settings/{docId}.description: Stores official TON treasury wallet and auto-withdrawal threshold settings

/deposits/{depositId}.description: Stores automatic TON Connect and Telegram Stars deposits

/referrals/{referralCode}.description: Stores unique user referral codes, full URLs, and TON/Stars commission split metrics

/referralCommissions/{commissionId}.description: Stores automatic TON/Stars referral commission deductions carved strictly out of the 15% site share
